title: The State and Fate of Linguistic Diversity and Inclusion in the NLP World

bias_targets.methodology: The authors propose a 6-class taxonomy of languages based on the availability of labeled and unlabeled data resources. They then evaluate language inclusivity and disparities in major NLP conferences over time by calculating language occurrence entropy, computing class-wise Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) based on language mentions in publications, and conducting entity embedding analysis to visualize relationships between languages, authors, and conference venues.
